wikipedia.extract: Alectoris is a genus of partridges in the family Phasianidae, closely related to Old World quail (Coturnix and relatives), snowcocks (Tetraogallus), partridge-francolins (Pternistis), bush quail (Perdicula), and sand and see-see partridges (Ammoperdix). Members of the genus are known collectively as rock partridges (a name that also refers to one species in particular, Alectoris graeca).
wikipedia.title: Alectoris

commonNames.name: Milne-Edwards's Sportive Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Milne-Edwards' sportive lemur (Lepilemur edwardsi), or Milne-Edwards' weasel lemur, is a species of lemur in the family Lepilemuridae. It is endemic to Madagascar.
wikipedia.title: Milne-Edwards' sportive lemur

commonNames.name: Chacma Baboon
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The chacma baboon (Papio ursinus), also known as the Cape baboon, is, like all other baboons, from the Old World monkey family. It is one of the largest of all monkeys.
wikipedia.title: Chacma baboon

wikipedia.extract: Cyanobacteria ( sy-AN-oh-bak-TEER-ee-ə) are a group of autotrophic gram-negative bacteria of the phylum Cyanobacteriota that can obtain biological energy via oxygenic photosynthesis. Cyanobacteria originated in a freshwater or terrestrial environment, and first appeared in the middle Archean eon.
wikipedia.title: Cyanobacteria

wikipedia.extract: Coracias is a genus of the rollers, an Old World family of birds related to the kingfishers and bee-eaters. They share the colourful appearance of those groups, blues and browns predominating.
wikipedia.title: Coracias

wikipedia.extract: Turacoena is a small genus of doves in the family Columbidae that are found in Indonesia. The genus was introduced in 1854 by the French naturalist Charles Lucien Bonaparte.
wikipedia.title: Turacoena

wikipedia.extract: Snowornis is a genus of birds in the family Cotingidae. The species were formerly included in the genus Lipaugus, The genus Snowornis was introduced in 2001 by Richard Prum with the grey-tailed piha as the type species.
wikipedia.title: Snowornis

commonNames.name: Auckland Teal
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Auckland teal (Anas aucklandica) (Māori: Tētē kākāriki), also known as Auckland Islands teal, is a species of dabbling duck of the genus Anas that is endemic to Auckland Islands south of New Zealand. The species was once found throughout the Auckland Islands, but is now restricted to the islands that lack introduced predators: Adams Island, Enderby Island, Disappointment Island and a few smaller islands.
wikipedia.title: Auckland teal

wikipedia.extract: The house sparrow (Passer domesticus) is a bird of the sparrow family Passeridae, found in most parts of the world. It is a small bird that has a typical length of 16 cm (6.3 in) and a mass of 24–39.5 g (0.85–1.39 oz).
wikipedia.title: House sparrow

wikipedia.extract: Reinwardtoena is a small genus of doves in the family Columbidae. They are found on parts of Indonesia, Papua New Guinea and the Solomon Islands.
wikipedia.title: Reinwardtoena

wikipedia.extract: Nyctiphrynus is a genus of birds in the nightjar family Caprimulgidae that are found in Middle and South America.
wikipedia.title: Nyctiphrynus

commonNames.name: Bengal Slow Loris
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The Bengal slow loris (Nycticebus bengalensis) or northern slow loris is a strepsirrhine primate and a species of slow loris native to the Bangladesh, Northeast India, Cambodia, Laos, Burma, Vietnam, southern China, and Thailand. Its geographic range is larger than that of any other slow loris species.
wikipedia.title: Bengal slow loris

commonNames.name: Betsileo Sportive Lemur
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Lepilemur betsileo Louis Jr., Engberg, Lei, Geng, Sommer, Randriamampionona, Randriamanana, Zaonarivelo et al., 2006

wikipedia.extract: The Betsileo sportive lemur (Lepilemur betsileo) is a sportive lemur endemic to Madagascar. Like all members of its genus, it is nocturnal and largely folivorous.
wikipedia.title: Betsileo sportive lemur

wikipedia.extract: The ornate titi monkey (Plecturocebus ornatus) is a species of titi monkey and is the smallest member of the family Pitheciidae, which also includes uakaris and saki monkeys. As it is a member of this family, it is classified as a type of New World monkey.
wikipedia.title: Ornate titi monkey

wikipedia.extract: Kenyapithecus wickeri is a fossil ape discovered by Louis Leakey in 1961 at a site called Fort Ternan in Kenya. The upper jaw and teeth were dated to 14 million years ago.
wikipedia.title: Kenyapithecus

commonNames.name: Milton’s Titi Monkey
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: Milton's titi monkey (Plecturocebus miltoni) is a species of titi monkey, a type of New World monkey, from southern Amazon rainforest, Brazil. It was named after the Brazilian primatologist Milton Thiago de Mello.
wikipedia.title: Milton's titi monkey

commonNames.name: White-cheeked Macaque
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

wikipedia.extract: The white-cheeked macaque (Macaca leucogenys) is a species of macaque found only in Mêdog County in southeastern Tibet and Arunachal Pradesh in northeastern India. The white-cheeked macaque lives in forest habitats, from tropical forests to primary and secondary evergreen broad-leaved forests and mixed broadleaf-conifer forests.
wikipedia.title: White-cheeked macaque

wikipedia.extract: The eastern black-handed tamarin (Saguinus ursulus) is a species of tamarin endemic to Brazil.
wikipedia.title: Eastern black-handed tamarin

wikipedia.extract: Miomancalla is an extinct genus of prehistoric flightless alcids that lived on the Pacific coast of today's California in the Miocene epoch. It contained two species, M. howardi and M. wetmorei.
wikipedia.title: Miomancalla

commonNames.name: Gursky’s Spectral Tarsier.
commonNames.source: The IUCN Red List of Threatened Species

gbif.scientificName: Tarsius spectrumgurskyae Shekelle, Groves, Maryanto & Mittermeier, 2017

wikipedia.extract: Gursky's spectral tarsier (Tarsius spectrumgurskyae), also known locally as wusing, is a species of tarsier found in the island of Sulawesi in Indonesia. A recent taxonomic revision split this species off from the spectral tarsier and other tarsier species based on difference in vocalisations and pelage.
wikipedia.title: Gursky's spectral tarsier
